description: Two players on level index 2. (1) The attract demo with player 2 added at the level start (partial restore): player 1 plays DEMO.DAT, player 2 reads DS:0000 (0 on this level) and stands still. (2) The attract demo with TWO selected on the title: player 2 is counted in but never created.

build.SETUP.DAT: shipped file (byte 0 = 1, byte 2 = 0: player 1 on the keyboard, player 2 without a controller)

emulator.cycles: bridge default; demo playback keeps the lag flag at 0

added: Fresh instance, boot to the passcode and type three keys; leave the title (ONE selected) until the attract demo starts.

Execute breakpoint at live 01F5:1F8D with cs:[8716] = 2: write record 1236:BE88 as a real two-player game leaves it at its level start (type 1, script 0x018A, flags 0x80/0xC0, facing 1, energy 0x40, owned 0x01, ammo 0x17F, weapon 1, lives 4) at camera + (0xC0, 0x78) with +18/+1A equal and +5C its cell; set [B098] = FFFF, [B09A] = 2 and [AD4E] + 1 (74FC counts the record).
Frame-end breakpoints at live 20EA:12BC with [AF84] = 50, 100 ... 1000: camera, flags B096-B09A, RNG, records BE1C + 8 x 0x6C.
selected: Fresh instance; on the title press Up, Up, Right (cs:1117 = 1, TWO); leave the title until the attract demo starts.
At 01F5:1F8D read [B092]-[B09A] and BE88; at the frame end with [AF84] = 100 read the camera, the flags, player 1, BE88 and the RNG.

inputs: DEMO.DAT for player 1 (no planned inputs); player 2 reads DS:0000 ([B094] = 0)

alignment.rule: A frame end with [AF84] = N is the port's flip of step N-1 (state.atFlip with state.recordFlip).
